description.narrative: The Central American Women's Fund (FCAM) ​​is a women's fund created with the purpose of contributing to the struggle of women's and feminist movements, recognizing their importance in the construction of significant social change through direct financing in Central America. FCAM works so that all girls, women, and trans and non-binary people enjoy a dignified and full life in communities that put them at the center of life. FCAM contributes to the strengthening of feminist and women's movements in the region, through direct financing, accompaniment, and the facilitation of opportunities that contribute to their sustainability and their struggles.
